correctness.rationale: For all integers \(N\ge2\), \(2\le k\le N\) and each attainable \(1\le r\le\min\{k,N-k+1\}\), the gap bijection and uniform weak-composition factorial moments establish the exact conditional mean. Pairwise distance summation uses the exact \(d\)- and \(d^2\)-weight identities; \(k=2\) is proved separately and \(N=k\) reduces correctly. The run-count covariance follows independently by an edge/pair overlap decomposition for \(N\ge4\) and direct treatment of \(N=2,3\). The standalone exact rational checker replays 16,278 subset samples, 45,020 gap-moment parameter cases, and 7,137 independent overlap covariances, but the all-size conclusion rests on the proof.

value.rationale: The count of runs of selected positions and the variance of their locations are distinct, mathematically natural measures of clustering versus spatial dispersion. The new exact conditional calibration \(\mathbb E[V\mid R=r]\) has a nonlinear strictly increasing factor \((r-1)/(r+1)\), and the covariance has the positive all-size factorization \((N-k)(N+k+1)/(6N)\). These are structural finite-population relationships not implied by marginal runs probabilities or \(\mathbb E[V]\). The result informs how two natural statistics can be interpreted jointly without asserting unproved power improvements.
